description: This Java class defines a utility for mapping a BSON array to a JSON array with customizable key name revision, used within a persistence layer involving MongoDB.

classes.name: BsonArrayToJsonObjectMapper
classes.description: An immutable class that provides a mapping function from BsonArray to JsonArray, allowing key name revisions through a configurable function.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BsonArrayToJsonObjectMapper with a specified key name reviser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts a BsonArray into a JsonArray, revising JSON object keys as per the configured function.
